train_supervised: train a supervised fastText model using input data with configurable epochs, learning rate, and word ngrams
test_model: test a trained fastText model against validation data to evaluate precision and recall
save_model: save a trained fastText model to a binary file for later loading and inference
quantize_model: quantize a trained fastText model with qnorm, retraining, and cutoff parameters for efficiency
print_results: print precision and recall metrics for a fastText model evaluation result
